model: RISH PFC 96 / PFC 144 automatic power factor controller
applies_to: Rishabh RISH PFC 96 and PFC 144 automatic power factor (APFC) controllers with RS-485 Modbus RTU, per interface definition version D (12/18).
summary: The RISH PFC 96 and PFC 144 are panel automatic power factor controllers that switch up to 12 capacitor banks while metering the line. Their RS-485 port speaks Modbus RTU and every value is an IEEE 754 float in two registers. This map covers the metering, demand, energy, max/min, THD, run-hour and per-bank kvar and switching-count registers (30001-30317) plus the main controller and communication settings.

addressing.note: The interface definition prints 3X/4X numbers next to the hex start address (30001 = 00 00, 30071 = 00 46, 40019 = 00 12). Wire address = number - 30001 (FC04) or - 40001 (FC03/FC16); every row here was checked against its printed hex.

source.title: Power Factor Controller PFC 144 - PFC 96 Interface Definition
source.pages: PDF pp. 7-9 (data format, examples), pp. 10-15 (3X table), pp. 23-36 (4X table and explanations)

notes: The data-format table states IEEE 754 floats, most significant byte first; the line-voltage example returns 43 6E FB 45. ABCD is the default and 40041 can reverse it.

Rows whose printed hex start address does not match their register number were left out (30169 and 30171 'old active import energy', and 40235 alarm relay status). The RTC date/time rows (30131, 30133) use a packed two-digit format and are also left out.
Left out: individual voltage/current harmonics (30321 onwards), alarm feature/set-point registers (Table 4), RTC set registers and display settings.
No unit column is printed, so units are left blank; energy follows 40005 (default kWh).
Register names drop the manual's superscript footnote markers (Imp = import, Exp = export, Ind = inductive, Cap = capacitive, OF = overflow).

integration.summary: Read 30001-30038 and 30071-30108 with FC04 for line values, demand and energy, and 30245-30317 for bank data, decoding each register pair as a big-endian float. Controller settings are floats in the 4X area written with FC16.
integration.enable: Set the RS-485 address and baud/parity in the controller's communication menu or via 40021/40019.
quirks: Reading or writing half a float returns exception 02.
Settings marked WP are write-protected: send the basic password (40071) or, for advanced settings, the advanced password (40205) first if one is set.
setup: Default setup code 5 = 9600 bps, no parity, 2 stop bits; device address 1.
gotchas: Capacitor discharge time (40129) must match the installed capacitors before banks are switched remotely.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
